Specification: This specification models the classic prisoner light-switch puzzle with a designated counter prisoner and a single shared lamp in a special cell. The model includes both the standard variant where the initial light state is known to be off and a harder variant where the initial light state is unknown; in the unknown case, non-counter prisoners may signal twice and the counter waits for a threshold of 2N - 1 instead of N. The system verifies that under weak fairness of the warden's prisoner selection, the prisoners eventually announce victory, and it also asserts a safety property that any victory announcement implies every prisoner has actually visited the cell.
IfThenElse: IF Light_Unknown THEN Cardinality(Prisoner) * 2 - 1 ELSE Cardinality(Prisoner)
IF light = "on" THEN /\ light' = "off" /\ count' = count + 1 ELSE UNCHANGED <<light, count>>
IF light = "off" /\ signalled[p] < SignalLimit THEN /\ light' = "on" /\ signalled' = [signalled EXCEPT ![p] = @ + 1] ELSE UNCHANGED <<light, signalled>>
